XenotypeDef.label: nanite humanoid
XenotypeDef.description: A human-form Replicator body assembled from microscopic nanites. Pegasus Asurans and compatible human-form Replicator individuals use this synthetic identity; political role, faction allegiance and sovereign authority are separate layers. Ordinary food is processed as matter feedstock for the body's Nanite Reserve.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A synthetic human form made from coordinated Replicator nanites.
